bull.b: Sustained, large revenue acceleration indicates renewed product demand and improving market traction. Over multiple quarters this trend supports stronger scale economics and revenue visibility, reducing execution risk for capacity expansion and R&D investments over the next several quarters.

bull.t: Record Mining Machine Sales & Product Traction
bull.b: Record hardware deliveries and meaningful consumer-product margins show product competitiveness and portfolio diversification. Higher unit shipments plus a consumer SKU with ~33% gross margin improve long-term revenue mix and margin sustainability as scale and product mix shift.

bull.t: Operational Scale, Crypto Treasury & Capital Support
bull.b: Rapid hashrate growth, a sizable crypto treasury and a $72M institutional investment materially boost liquidity and optionality. Crypto holdings and capital support can fund operations, backstop expansion, and enable strategic projects (data centers, energy initiatives) beyond periodic cash-flow swings.

bear.b: Ongoing negative gross and net margins and recurring negative operating/free cash flow indicate the company still struggles to convert revenue into sustainable profits. Over months this weak cash generation increases reliance on external funding and pressurizes investment in R&D and capex.

bear.t: Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Noncompliance Risk
bear.b: A formal deficiency notice elevates delisting risk, which can impair access to US capital markets, increase liquidity premia and distract management. Over the medium term this structural listing risk may force dilutive actions or corporate steps that affect strategic flexibility.

bear.t: Rising Mining Costs, Impairments and Operational Expenses
bear.b: Higher structural operating costs from tariffs, one-time efficiency charges and impairments point to margin pressure and execution risk. If tariffs and efficiency investments persist, they will erode unit economics and require sustained higher pricing or efficiency gains to maintain profitability.
